body:
## Description
This Minecraft plugin adds various wands to the game inspired by The Kingdom by DusDavidGames, each with its own unique spells. The plugin also includes a system to manage tamed Ender Dragons, similar to those by the kingdom Ljord.

## Features
- Multiple Wands:
    - Empire Wand
    - Wortel Wand
    - Bloedmagie
    - Zeis Der Mephidantes
    - Rafgtagar Wand
- Dragon System:
    - Spawn and manage Ender Dragons

## Commands
Wand Commands
- /empirewand - Gives the Empire Wand to the player
- /worteland - Gives the Wortel Wand to the player
- /bloedmagie - Gives Bloedmagie to the player
- /hoe - Gives the Zeis Der Mephidantes to the player
- /dagger - Gives the Theros Dagger to the player
- /rafg - Gives the Rafgtagar Wand to the player
Dragon Commands
- /dragon spawn - Spawn a new dragon
- /dragon remove - Remove a dragon
- /dragon locate - Find the location of your dragons
- /dragon egg - Manage dragon eggs

## Installation
1. Download the .jar file
2. Place the file in the plugins folder of your Minecraft server
3. Restart the server
   
The plugin is now ready to use

## Permissions
- wands.dragon.* - All dragon-related permissions
    - wands.dragon.spawn: Spawn a dragon
    - wands.dragon.egg: Get a dragon egg
    - wands.dragon.locate: Locate your dragons
    - wands.dragon.remove: Remove your dragons
    - wands.dragon.ride: Control your dragons
    - wands.dragon.hurt.self: Allow damaging your own dragon
    - wands.dragon.hurt.others: Allow damaging other players’ dragons
    - wands.dragon.bypass.owner: Control any dragon, even if it is not yours
